coordinate_system: decoded RGB512x288, top-left origin, x right, y down; animal anatomical left/right (front-facing means image-right is animal-left)
mapping_note: APT-36K inspired semantic names only, not an official annotation import; tail_base is our explicit definition of the paper's tail keypoint. No pose model used.
point_contract: visible -> xy:[x,y], uncertainty_px>0, note; occluded/unobservable -> xy:null, uncertainty_px:null, note. NOT_ANNOTATED -> no invented coordinates.
contact_contract: Each paw has evidence visible_evidence/possible/unknown; touching true/false/null; note. 2D image evidence is not weight-bearing or 3D proof.
frame_contract: frame0..16, time_seconds=frame/24, instance_id=source-dog-1, viewed_individually boolean, annotation_status, bbox_xyxy or null, camera_note, landmarks keyed by all17 IDs, contacts for4paws, note
normalization: xy/[512,288] only. Anatomical root-relative coordinates NOT_COMPUTED if pelvis/body scale unresolved. Visible proxies are not joint centers.
uncertainty: Manual low-resolution image observations. No interpolation as truth. Finite differences only adjacent manually annotated visible points; report px/s with independent worst-case uncertainty 24*(radius_t+radius_t1), never treat subuncertainty motion as measured truth.
torso_and_heading: 3D heading and joint angles are not inferred. Torso angle is unavailable when anatomical shoulder/hip centers are unresolved.
visibility_colors: Stable per-ID palette defined in renderer; representative 3x panels include text IDs. Null joints not drawn.
private_data: Actual coordinates, source images, overlays and paths stay private. Only this schema and generic code may be public.
